title: CNNs & RNNs for Text
motto: Convolutions learn n-grams. Recurrences remember. Both are superseded by attention. Both still matter on constrained hardware.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Convolutions learn n-grams. Recurrences remember. Both are superseded by attention. Both still matter on constrained hardware.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: TF-IDF and Word2Vec produced flat vectors that ignored word order. A classifier built on them could not tell `dog bites man` from `man bites dog`. Word order sometimes carries the signal.
Two families of architectures filled that gap before transformers arrived.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: 1D convs capture n-gram patterns. RNNs maintain hidden state across sequence steps.
